facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A princess had a golden ball. She played by the well. The ball fell in. She dropped her ball.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Once upon a time, a beautiful princess lived in a castle. She loved playing with her golden ball by the well. One day, the ball slipped out of her hands. She dropped her ball and it fell into the deep well. The princess was shocked and started to cry. Her precious golden ball disappeared into the dark water.
